integrity.scope: self-contained analytic proof with exact finite diagnostic; finite checks do not prove the infinite claim

scientific_limitations: Uniform ellipticity and mutual independence across time-and-cardinality coefficient blocks are required.
The exponent 1/2 is a bound for conditional empirical-bracket mean square and is not asserted optimal.
No quenched path-space convergence rate or time-invariant cardinality-parameter analogue is proved.
Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Quenched invariance and a quantitative quadratic-variation bound for independently resampled one-factor bootstrap walks
